notes.title: Update notes for April 10
notes.content: Hey alpha testers, version 0.2.12 is live and available to play. This release has the Cave of the Lost, the wall breaker ability, and you can enter the Oracle's Castle. It also have improved UI and equip system but you'll notice some parts of menu system have not been updated (yet!). Looking forward to hearing your feedback. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Updates for Jan 26
notes.content:
Hi Alphas! Thanks for being rad. This release (0.1.18) has fixes for the following:

 Crates can be picked up from below without launching the player
 Inventory is reset for new games
 Eliminated ability to swim up waterfalls
 Fixed issue where unloaded objects would not save (ie: seeing the glider cutscene twice)
 Prevent two crates from being placed on one vine
 Removed vertical speed from glider initial velocity
 Modified open cutscene skip instructions
 World building fixes

notes.title: Updates for Jan 3 (0.1.14)
notes.content:
Hey alpha testers. Thanks for continuing to help me make the game better. I have a minor update for your review and testing:


 Performance improvements (lets get more devices to hit 60fps)
 Intercative UI elements have been moved over the interactive instead of over the player
 Added mouse menu controls (nerd alert: menu interface moved to dedicated UI controller)
 Player movement allowed before introduction starts
 Minor changes to player control and player effects

notes.title: Updates for January 1
notes.content:
Hey alpha testers! Thanks for your amazing support and finding so many issues that I was not able to identify. Good work! All the feedback posted to Discord has been amazing and I'll address all items as soon as possible. But this release solves some of the high priority items.


 Fixed issue where player could stand on NPCs, fire, and enemies
 Removed pits in terrain where player could get stuck
 Added check for "stuck" player and allow player to jump out of it
 Added temporary collider to prevent jumping over Fang Weed in cave until player death is implemented
 Added checks for screen aspect ratio prevent growing the screen beyond 16:9
 Fixed bug where player may start running after dialogue has ended without any user input
 Removed mouse controls on Start Menu (full mouse controls will be available in the future)
 Modified dialogue selection sound
 Spelling and grammar fixes
 Added revision number to title screen
